scenes.title: Ancient Rule
scenes.text: Dinosaurs ruled the Earth for over a hundred and sixty million years, long before humans ever walked here.

scenes.title: The Impact
scenes.text: Sixty six million years ago, an asteroid struck Earth and wiped out almost every dinosaur in a short time.

scenes.title: Sky Blocked
scenes.text: The impact kicked up so much dust that sunlight vanished for months, and the food chain collapsed.

scenes.title: Still Alive
scenes.text: But the dinosaurs never fully disappeared. Modern birds are living dinosaurs, descended from feathered ancestors.

scenes.title: Feathers First
scenes.text: Feathers came before flight, evolved for warmth and display long before any dinosaur ever took to the sky.

scenes.title: Small Giants
scenes.text: Some dinosaurs were no bigger than a chicken, while others grew longer than a bus and heavier than a truck.

scenes.title: Every Continent
scenes.text: Fossils have been found on every continent, proving these animals once walked the entire planet.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: The dinosaurs are still here, just smaller and feathered. Which dinosaur would you want to see alive?
